title: I Returned the Expired Parking Validation With the Stamp Time Circled

parts.text: I parked for a 20-minute pickup and the garage sold me a validation that had expired at 9:00 a.m. The stamp still said yesterday. I was thirty-three, holding a crying toddler and a circled 9:00. Attendant Mo said, "Validations are vibes." I pointed at the machine policy: STAMP TIME GOVERNS. NO YESTERDAY INK. He shrugged. I photographed the circle, paid the honest hour, and returned the expired stub in the complaint slot with the photo. Corporate credited both the hour and the validation. Mo stamps today. The gate finally believes clocks.

social.video_title: The validation was yesterday's ink — Part 1/1
social.description: Toddler, a 9:00 circle, and vibe as a policy. Corporate credited the hour. Has a stamp ever time-traveled?
